summary: No fatal error. The large-distance statements the design makes (single floating insertions, odd P-edge pairs, log T times an O(eps) cut tree along K, T-independence by the flow) survive; the UV-boundary formula at finite T is right and no K_T vertex enters the defect census. Six major problems: (1) the design does not account for the Part-D4 engine finding P_1 != 0 (composite A_V--c line): thm:o-KD, eq:o-SQ, the freedom tables and E8/E10c/E11 assume P_1 = 0 'by covariance', and the K_1 and S_1 predictions shift by -c times the classical transformation when P_1 = c{S^(1)(P_b),-}; (2) Lemma lem:o-legs and the large-distance analysis omit the even-even P-edge pairs (two floating even insertions joined by A_V x A_V); (3) thm:o-classes / eq:o-L1graphs are incomplete for gauge-variant O (letters); (4) the scheme-freedom analysis misses position-dependent field redefinitions, in particular phi^(0) = a S^(1)(Delta), which is exactly the direction that moves P_1, K_1, Q_1, S_1 by classical multiples, and the proof of prop:o-GB (ii) (and ch08 prop:c8-B) is incomplete; (5) E10c has no exact procedure and the engines' canonical form lacks second derivatives of delta; (6) E11 and E10c comparison targets are wrong as stated (consequence of 1).

findings.claim: Floating insertions are adjacent only as odd-odd P-edge pairs through lambda x lambda ('two floating odd insertions are adjacent only through a lambda x lambda edge; a floating even insertion and a floating odd insertion are never adjacent'); the large-distance analysis and the T-safety lists cover single insertions and odd P-edge pairs only.
findings.evidence: census_ir.py (from the propagator table of ch03 prop:c3-P / ch08 prop:c8-twocomp): two floating even insertions (v.A_V, A*_V) are adjacent through the A_V x A_V component, giving a chain c --A*c-- x1 --A_V A_V-- x2 --A*c-- c with two ghost ends; its degree at large distance in R^8 is dv1 + dv2 - 2 per orientation (dv = 0, 1, 1, 2 for P, so(V), Delta, K): (K,P), (Delta,M), (M,M'): 0 (log); (K,Delta), (K,M): 1; (K,K'): 2. koszul_orientation.py: the two orientations of an even-even chain carry the relative Koszul sign -1 exactly as for odd-odd chains (A*, c odd, A even), so the z-independent leading term cancels and the degree drops by one: (K,P), (Delta,M), (M,M'), (P,x) converge only after the orientation sum, (K,Delta), (K,M) are logarithmic and (K,K') grows as T^(1/2) at finite T (times O(eps) in defect graphs). Even-odd adjacency is indeed impossible and same-chirality odd pairs are not adjacent (census). The (Delta,Delta) component vanishes by graded antisymmetry in even arguments.

findings.claim: K_1 is obtained exactly as the eps -> 0 limit at fixed T of the K-route graphs, tested at T = 1, 4, 16 (units of the external momenta); E9 uses T = infinity for the (xi,eta) arity-two component because the P-edge pairs converge after the orientation sum.
findings.evidence: No exact procedure for the eps -> 0 limit at fixed T is given; numerical evaluation at three values of T can test but not establish T-independence, against the plan's own exactness rule (exact integration or >= 40 digits + integer relation). S^(1)(K_b) is quadratic in x (v^m = x^2 b^m - 2(b.x)x^m), and so is S^(2)(eta1,eta2) (gauge parameter -((x,x)v1 - 2(v1,x)x)); the engines' canonical two-point form is alpha delta + beta^mu d_mu delta only (engine_a/delta_results.json conventions.canonical_form; engine_b same), so the K route needs gamma^{mu nu} d_mu d_nu delta, not listed in E0. Each orientation of a (xi,eta) P-edge pair alone has degree 0 (S^3 average 2 eta.xi, design thm:o-ir (iv); census_ir.py), so a graph-by-graph evaluation at T = infinity diverges.
findings.fix: E10c: (i) prove per graph that the eps -> 0 limit at fixed T equals the eps^0 coefficient of the scaled-Schwinger expansion of Part C with P-edge times tau in [1, T/eps) -> [1, infinity), the large-distance term being of order eps (thm:o-ir (ii)), and check that the Taylor order needed for the output weight converges at large tau; compute that coefficient exactly (rational + explicit log/Li_2 basis, >= 40 digits + PSLQ confirmed twice); (ii) use finite T (T|p|^2 = 1, 4, 16, eps|p|^2 -> 0) only as a numerical cross-check of T-independence; (iii) compare with the corrected targets of G1. E0: extend the canonical form by gamma^{mu nu}(p) d_mu d_nu delta (both engines) and test it on {S^(1)(K_b), int(A,A)}. E9 (and every arity-two P-edge pair at T = infinity): sum the two orientations and the two chirality assignments in one integrand before integrating, or integrate at finite T and take T -> infinity after the sum. Resources and portability as planned are adequate (pure Python, < 1 GB; the audit scripts peaked at 78 MB).

open_issues: CH08: def:c8-radial: 'Assume the local representatives along P_n and K_n exist, with P_1=0 (Proposition c7-cov)' attributes P_1 = 0 to the covariance of the regulator, which does not imply it; evidence: Part D4 engine B and step2/qa/compare_delta.json give P_1 = -(1/3+f_P) unit {S^(1)(P_b),-} on the scalar bilinears from the composite A|_V--c line ((Q^GF)^2 != 0), -f_P on letters; scheme_shift_check.py shows the forced companion shifts of K_1, Q_1, S_1; proposed fix: replace 'with $P_1=0$ (Proposition \ref{prop:c7-cov})' by 'with $P_1=0$ on the operators considered; in Feynman gauge this is a scheme condition, since the composite line of Remark \ref{rem:c7-internal} gives $P_1=c\,\{S^{(1)}(P_n),-\}$ on the scalar bilinears, and the finite part $\psi'=c\cdot(\text{Weyl weight})$ on that family removes it while changing the components along $K_b$, $\Sigma$ and $\Sigma^*$ by $+c$, $-\tfrac c2$ and $+\tfrac c2$ times the classical transformations'.

CH08: prop:c8-B (proof, 'Independence'): the averaging argument concludes that phi^(0) is a combination of the field-counting functionals, but position-dependent invariant functionals of degree -1 and weight 4 exist (e.g. S^(1)(Delta)), and phi^(0) proportional to S^(1)(Delta) solves the S_+ (x) W equation because {S^(1)(xi),S^(1)(Delta)} = -S^(1)([xi,Delta]) is the same multiple of S^(1)(xi) on all of Sigma; evidence: ch02 def:c2-S1even, ch08 cor:c8-homotopy (ii), scheme_shift_check.py (B); proposed fix: replace 'averaging over the compact forms ... a contradiction.' by 'averaging over the compact forms of $\mathrm{Spin}(4)\times SU(4)$ and of the gauge group, $\phi^{(0)}$ may be taken invariant; besides the field-counting functionals $\sum_fa_f\int(f,f^*)$ the invariant local functionals of degree $-1$ and Weyl weight $4$ contain position-dependent ones such as $S^{(1)}(\Delta)$, whose brackets with $S^{(1)}(\xi)$ give one multiple $u\,S^{(1)}(\xi)$ common to all $\xi\in\Sigma$. Along $\xi\in S_+\otimes W$ and along $\xi^{\prime}\in S_-\otimes W^*$, where $G_B$ takes the values $+1$ and $-1$, the four linear terms of $S^{(1)}(\xi)$, resp. $S^{(1)}(\xi^{\prime})$, then require four differences of the $a_f$ equal to $\epsilon-u$, resp. $-\epsilon-u$, with $\epsilon=\pm1$ the sign of the evaluation; each set of four differences sums to $0$, so $u=\epsilon$ and $u=-\epsilon$, a contradiction.'
